Assistant Store Keeper post stands cancelled
Wednesday, 10 May 2023
3083 Hits
This is for the information of all concerned that the Written and Computer Skill Test for the post of Assistant Store Keeper held on 06/04/2023 stands cancelled.
The post is re-advertised in the daily newspaper “The Hitavada” dated 09/05/2023. Those fulfilling the required eligibility may re-apply.
DEAN
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
